data.one_liner: Easily customizable dialogs, progress dialogs, zoomable dialogs, and animated transitions in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized dialog types (NDialog, NAlertDialog, ZoomDialog) and progress dialogs that can be automatically tied to Futures or displayed using extensions like .show(context). It also supports blurred backgrounds and animated show transitions.
use_when: You want to easily show progress dialogs tied to a Future's execution.
You need blurred or customized backgrounds for dialogs without heavy boilerplate.
You want animated transition effects when displaying native or custom dialogs.
avoid_when: Your project requires complex custom routing or state-managed navigation stacks for overlays.
You prefer pure declarative widget state architectures for managing dialog visibility.
strengths: Convenient extensions on Futures to automatically show and dismiss progress dialogs.
Supports multiple custom dialog types and zoomable dialogs out of the box.
Easy customization of blur effects and transition animations.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on imperative show/dismiss methods rather than strict declarative widget trees.
Tightly coupled to specific Flutter SDK versions as noted in recent changelogs.
